直接问：每段资料一次写完这一段的题，一个知识点一道短题，调用最少。短情境：同样一: Ask directly: each part of the material gets its questions in one call, one short question per knowledge point, the fewest calls. Short scenario: also written in one call, every question set in a short scenario whose decisive condition decides the answer; it writes a little more than “Ask directly”. Design first: the targets are planned and the answers designed first, then the questions are written, reviewed and repaired in batches; slower and uses more tokens, for the strictest decks. Questions written in one call are checked by the program (quotes, options, the number per part) and reviewed in batches against the text around each quote; one that fails is dropped.
只有单选题能选写法；其他题型总是先设计再写。续出和补题沿用题组开始时的写法（没有: Only single-choice questions have a choice of writing method; other question types are always “Design first”. Continuing or topping up a deck keeps the method it was started with (an old deck with no record is “Design first”, an old one-pass deck is “Short scenario”); rewriting questions that failed is always “Design first”.
